definitions.gloss: separated; apart from one another; scattered
definitions.explanation: The state of people (or things) who were once together being apart and unable to be together. Most often used of family or close friends who become separated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになった。
examples.english: Parent and child were separated by the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取|と}り{合|あ}っている→取り合う：12000_toriau⟧。
examples.english: I was separated from my friends when we went on to different schools, but we still keep in touch.

notes:
Formed by reduplicating ⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ (to be apart); the second {離|はな}れ voices to ばなれ. Almost always appears with なる or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, as in {離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become separated
- {離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live apart
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れ: a family scattered apart

USAGE:
Carries an emotional, often sad nuance of people who wish to be together but cannot be.
